headline: Asian Energy Services Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement - Asian Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of certified true copy of the final order by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ('Hon'ble Tribunal') in the matter of Scheme…
detail: Scheme of Arrangement - Asian Energy Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of certified true copy of the final order by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench ('Hon'ble Tribunal') in the matter of Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Oilmax Energy Private Limited ('OEPL' or 'Transferor Company') with Asian Energy Services Limited ('AESL' or 'Transferee Company' or 'the Company') and their respective shareholders ('Scheme').

sources.name: NSE filing - Asian Energy Services Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
